title: Deep Learning Approach for Pitting Corrosion Detection in Gas Pipelines
summary: A CNN detected pitting corrosion in gas-pipeline imagery using a labeled corrosion-image dataset and optimized model evaluation. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
